content.label: Orders
content.headline: Orders buried in multiple places?
content.pain: Orders come in by phone, chat and email, all at once. One gets lost in the scroll, and you only find out when the customer calls asking where it is.
content.whatif: What if every order, from every channel, landed in one place, logged and tracked from the moment it came in?
outcome: → No order missed. No festive sale lost.
